description: REAL: NBK rates via Frankfurter v2. One row per rate observation returned by the fetch made for _arrival_date.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: nbk. Taken from the request: the response rows do not carry it.

fields.name: base
fields.description: USD. NBK publishes KZT per 1 USD.

fields.name: rate_date
fields.description: Date in the API row. Weekdays only for this provider, so earlier than requested_to on weekends.

fields.name: rate_text
fields.description: NBK rate, digits exactly as Frankfurter returned them, for example 453.71. Cast to NUMERIC only in dbt.

fields.name: requested_from
fields.description: First day of the request window: _arrival_date minus 6 days.

fields.name: requested_to
fields.description: Last day of the request window: _arrival_date.

fields.name: fetched_at
fields.description: When the fetch ran, UTC. Frozen in the meta file, so reloads do not change it.

fields.name: _arrival_date
fields.description: Partition column: the run date R whose fetch returned this row.

fields.name: _source_file
fields.description: Landed body path, relative to the landing folder.
